purpose: Daily morning market brief specification consumed by PB-AI/ChatGPT from the Observatory market SSOT.

source_priority.name: Finviz S&P 500 Map
source_priority.fallback: If unavailable, do not invent breadth. Use the Observatory sector-ETF breadth proxy only when explicitly labeled as a proxy.

source_priority.name: Finviz Calendar
source_priority.fallback: Use Observatory economic-calendar.json for canonical schedule/actuals and retain the Finviz link as the preferred web cross-check.

source_priority.name: TradingView
source_priority.fallback: Use canonical Observatory market series when TradingView cannot be verified; preserve the observed source and timestamp.

source_priority.name: Slickcharts Nasdaq 100 Components
source_priority.fallback: If unavailable, leave concentration values null and mark DEGRADED.

source_priority.name: CNN Fear & Greed Index
source_priority.fallback: If unavailable, leave values null and mark DEGRADED.

freshness_policy.finality_check: Single FINAL capture only; no provisional 20-minute snapshot.
freshness_policy.daylight_saving: DST-aware; 05:35 KST in US daylight time and 06:35 KST in US standard time.
freshness_policy.closed_market_rule: When the US market is closed or a source has not rolled forward, use the latest completed trading session and explicitly state the market date. Never estimate missing values.
freshness_policy.production_write_policy: Scheduled production data is written once per completed US session at the FINAL capture. Code push/PR validation must not publish a new market snapshot.

fact_boundary.raw: Observed numbers, source, market date, observed timestamp and source status only.
fact_boundary.derived: Deterministic rule outputs calculated from raw fields only.
fact_boundary.commentary: Natural-language explanation generated downstream; never stored as a raw fact.
